papers.title: Viscoelasticity of synthetic antigen presenting cells reprograms T cell metabolism for TCR-T cell manufacturing and therapy
papers.abstract_en: Adoptive T cell receptor (TCR)–based immunotherapy offers a powerful strategy to target solid tumors. However, how the physical properties of the antigen-presenting interface regulate T cell metabolic programming remains poorly defined. Here we develop synthetic viscoelastic activating cells (SynVAC), artificial antigen-presenting cells whose stress-relaxation kinetics are chemically tuned independently of stiffness and of peptide–MHC (pMHC) and co-stimulatory ligand density. SynVAC-pMHC provides a defined, scalable platform that outperforms monocyte-derived dendritic cells to enrich antigen-specific CD8 + T cells. Fast-relaxing SynVAC-pMHC amplifies TCR signaling and mTOR activity, drives metabolic changes, and programs antigen-specific T cells toward an energetically favorable state with improved memory-like features after expansion. TCR-T cells expanded using fast-relaxing SynVAC-pMHC exhibit superior persistence and durable antitumor activity in melanoma and ovarian cancer models. These results establish cell-mimetic viscoelasticity as a key biophysical cue governing T cell metabolism and differentiation and offer a fully synthetic strategy for manufacturing potent TCR-T cells.
papers.summary_ko: 연구진은 응력 완화 속도를 독립적으로 조절할 수 있는 합성 점탄성 항원제시세포(SynVAC)를 개발했다. 빠르게 응력이 완화되는 SynVAC-pMHC는 TCR 신호전달과 mTOR 활성을 증대시켜 항원특이적 CD8+ T세포의 대사를 에너지 효율적인 상태로 재프로그래밍한다. 이를 통해 제작된 TCR-T 세포는 흑색종과 난소암 모델에서 우수한 지속성과 항종양 효과를 보였다. 배터리와는 무관한 면역세포치료 연구이다.

papers.title: Tuning Ligand Accessibility via Solvation Entropy for Universal Recovery of Spent Ternary Cathodes
papers.abstract_en: Industrial recycling of spent lithium-ion batteries is challenged by increasingly heterogeneous feedstocks with highly variable cathode compositions. Such compositional fluctuations undermine selective metal separation and necessitate complex process regulation and excessive chemical consumption. In this study, we develop a high-entropy deep eutectic solvent (HE-DES) through solvation entropy engineering to regulate ligand accessibility and competitive metal-ligand interactions. This facilitates the dissolution of Li, Co, and Mn while selectively enriching Ni in recovered solids from diverse spent NCM cathodes. For NCM111, the metal-normalized Ni fraction reaches 94.40%, with a Ni-to-impurity enrichment ratio of 16.86, approximately 3.6 times that of the low-entropy counterpart. Molecular simulations reveal diversified local solvation structures and reorganized ligand-solvent associations in HE-DES, accompanied by enhanced ligand mobility and distinct Ni/Co coordination environments. Meanwhile, the multicomponent solvent regulates ligand-associated chemical environments at the solid-liquid interface, facilitating selective nickel oxalate formation during cathode dissolution. This work establishes solvent microenvironment engineering as a complementary design principle to conventional ligand engineering, opening new opportunities for selective metal separation in complex multimetal systems.
papers.summary_ko: 폐 삼원계(NCM) 양극재의 불균일한 조성 문제를 해결하기 위해 용매화 엔트로피를 조절한 고엔트로피 deep eutectic solvent(HE-DES)를 개발했다. 이 용매는 Li, Co, Mn을 선택적으로 용해시키면서 Ni을 고형물에 농축시켜 NCM111 기준 Ni 분율 94.40%, 저엔트로피 대비 약 3.6배 높은 Ni/불순물 농축비를 달성했다. 분자 시뮬레이션을 통해 리간드-용매 재구성과 Ni/Co 배위환경 차이가 선택적 분리의 원인임을 규명했다. 폐배터리 금속 회수(재활용) 연구로 7개 토픽 범주에는 해당하지 않는다.

papers.title: Transition-Metal-Mediated Discharge Intermediates Set Anionic-Redox Potentials and Voltage Hysteresis in Li-Rich Cathodes
papers.venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.abstract_en: Voltage hysteresis arising from anionic redox reactions remains a central bottleneck for lithium-rich cathodes. While ligand-to-metal charge transfer (LMCT) has been invoked to describe the charging pathway, its proposed reverse counterpart, metal-to-ligand charge transfer (MLCT), remains experimentally unresolved during discharge. Here, using cation-disordered rock-salt Li2Ni0.33Ta0.66O3 (LNTO) as a model system, we combine electrochemical relaxation analysis with synchrotron-based spectroscopy to identify, for the first time, a metastable reduction intermediate characterized by Ni(2-δ)+/(O–O)n− during discharge, thereby providing direct experimental validation for the MLCT framework. The discovery of this metastable intermediate demonstrates that discharge proceeds through a two-step electrochemical–chemical pathway, wherein the spontaneous relaxation evolution of the metastable intermediate drives free-energy dissipation and voltage hysteresis. Guided by this picture, Ru substitution was introduced to modulate the cation–anion electronic structure, enabling Ru 4d–O 2p hybridization to generate persistent low-energy hole states that lower the energy of the metastable discharge intermediate and shift O–O dimer reduction to higher potentials. We further show that the discharge intermediate serves as the energetic link through which transition-metal electronic structure governs the effective anionic-redox potential. This work provides a discharge-side thermodynamic framework for understanding and mitigating voltage hysteresis in Li-rich anionic-redox cathodes.
papers.summary_ko: 무질서 암염형 Li2Ni0.33Ta0.66O3(LNTO)를 모델로 하여 방전 시 Ni(2-δ)+/(O–O)n− 준안정 환원 중간체를 처음으로 실험적으로 규명해 금속-리간드 전하전이(MLCT) 경로를 입증했다. 이 중간체의 자발적 이완이 자유에너지 소모와 전압 히스테리시스를 유발함을 밝히고, Ru 치환을 통해 Ru 4d–O 2p 혼성화로 저에너지 정공 상태를 형성시켜 O–O 다이머 환원 전위를 높이는 전략을 제시했다. 전이금속 전자구조가 방전측 음이온 레독스 전위를 결정하는 열역학적 틀을 제공한다.

papers.title: Taming Metal–Electrolyte Interface via Two-Dimensional Organic Metal Chalcogenide Colloids for Anode-Free Sodium Metal Batteries
papers.venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.abstract_en: Anode-free metal batteries are promising candidates for next-generation energy storage technologies, yet their application is severely limited by dendrite growth and rapid capacity decay induced by an unstable metal–electrolyte interface. Herein, we propose a “colloid electrolyte” strategy employing coordination polymer nanosheets as electrolyte additives for constructing anode-free sodium metal batteries (AFSMBs). Unlike conventional molecular additives or inert particle suspensions, these colloidal nanosheets provide spatially organized and continuously available interfacial reaction domains, thereby spatially regulating electrolyte component distribution and interfacial reactions. These nanosheets, composed of AgS layers uniformly decorated with fluorinated groups, undergo in situ decomposition at the metal–electrolyte interface. This process generates gradient distributions of Ag nanoparticles and NaF/Na2S species, which guide the spontaneous formation of a functionally graded solid electrolyte interphase (SEI). This hierarchical SEI enables dendrite-free Na deposition and imparts sustained interfacial protection during cycling. Consequently, high-cathode-loading AFSMBs achieve an ultralong lifespan (>1600 cycles), representing a 10-fold improvement over counterpart cells without the colloidal additive. Notably, 0.5-Ah-level anode-free pouch cells exhibit stable cycling for 500 cycles at 2 C. This work establishes coordination polymer colloids as a new class of electrolyte additives for advanced alkali metal batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 무음극(anode-free) 소듐금속전지의 덴드라이트와 계면 불안정성을 해결하기 위해 불소화 AgS 배위고분자 나노시트를 전해질 첨가제로 사용하는 '콜로이드 전해질' 전략을 제안했다. 이 나노시트는 계면에서 분해되어 Ag 나노입자와 NaF/Na2S로 구성된 구배형 SEI를 형성, 덴드라이트 없는 Na 증착을 유도한다. 고용량 양극을 적용한 무음극 셀은 기존 대비 10배 향상된 1600회 이상의 수명을 보였으며, 0.5 Ah 파우치셀도 2C에서 500회 안정적으로 구동되었다.

papers.title: Spatial-Mechanical-Chemical Synergy in Inorganic-Shelled Cavities Enables Stable Li–Mg Alloy Anodes
papers.abstract_en: Lithium metal batteries promise ultrahigh energy density yet are plagued by catastrophic lithium dendrites and severe volume expansion. Conventionally, rational three-dimensional (3D) host architectures have been developed to mitigate dendrite proliferation and mechanical stress. However, the structural collapse of lithium-hosting frameworks under dynamic plating/stripping conditions remains a critical bottleneck. Herein, we overcome this limitation by designing a Li-Mg alloy framework integrated with LiNO3 (LMLN), which yields in situ-formed cavities encapsulated by inorganic shells of high ionic conductivity that kinetically guide inward lithium deposition and promote uniform nucleation via tailored interfacial chemistry. The resulting spatial-mechanical-chemical coupling, realized by a scalable roller-pressing process, delivers a triadic synergy of spatially confined deposition, mechanically robust architecture, and chemically functional interfaces. Consequently, LMLN-based lithium metal batteries paired with commercial lithium-sulfur electrolytes and LiFePO4 (LFP) cathodes achieve 95.6% capacity retention over 300 cycles. Notably, a 1 Ah pouch cell pairing an 80 μm LMLN anode with a 17.5 mg cm–2 LFP cathode achieves 85.6% retention over 400 cycles at 1 C alongside intrinsic thermal safety under nail penetration. This dual achievement of superior 1 C cycle life and thermal robustness in 1 Ah LFP-Li metal pouch cells underscores its potential for moderate-rate, low-voltage storage applications.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬-마그네슘 합금 프레임워크에 LiNO3를 결합한 LMLN 구조를 설계하여 무기 쉘로 둘러싸인 공극을 형성, 리튬을 내부로 균일하게 유도 증착시켜 덴드라이트와 부피 팽창 문제를 완화했다. 공간-역학-화학적 시너지를 통해 LMLN 기반 리튬금속전지는 Li-S 전해질과 LFP 양극 조합에서 300회 사이클 후 95.6% 용량 유지율을 달성했다. 1 Ah 파우치셀(80 μm LMLN 음극, LFP 양극)은 1C에서 400회 사이클 후 85.6% 유지율과 못 관통 시험에서도 열적 안전성을 보였다.

papers.title: Rethinking Creep in Solid-State Batteries: From a Chemo-mechanical Liability to a Design Parameter
papers.abstract_en: Creep is an inherent time-dependent mechanical response in alkali-metal-based solid-state batteries (SSBs) subjected to sustained stack pressure. Although creep can significantly influence battery performance, its role has often been interpreted narrowly as either a beneficial mechanism for maintaining interfacial contact or a detrimental contributor to cell degradation. In this perspective, we establish a unified conceptual framework by linking sustained loading in the classical definition of creep to stack pressure in SSBs, thereby explaining why creep is intrinsic to their operation. We further argue that creep should be regarded as a chemo-mechanical phenomenon with inherently dual roles, whose competing effects govern the dynamic evolution of electrode–electrolyte interfaces during electrochemical cycling. Finally, we discuss how timescale-based design principles and time-resolved in situ and operando characterization can deepen understanding and guide the rational optimization of creep under practical battery operating conditions, thereby informing the design of durable next-generation alkali-metal SSBs.
papers.summary_ko: 알칼리금속 기반 전고체전지에서 지속적인 스택 압력에 의해 발생하는 크리프(creep) 현상을 단순한 유해 요인이 아니라 설계 변수로 재해석하는 관점 논문이다. 크리프를 고전적 정의의 지속 하중과 연결하여 전고체전지에 내재적인 현상으로 설명하고, 전극-전해질 계면의 동적 변화를 지배하는 화학-역학적 이중 역할을 논의한다. 시간 분해 in situ/operando 특성분석과 시간축 기반 설계 원칙을 통한 차세대 알칼리금속 전고체전지 최적화 방향을 제시한다.

papers.title: Nanofriction strengthened mechanically adaptive electrolytes for safe lithium metal batteries
papers.abstract_en: The expanding application of lithium metal batteries in emerging fields such as unmanned aerial vehicles and humanoid robots exposes them to heightened risks of mechanical abuse, which has become a critical factor contributing to safety failures. To address this predicament, we design a mechanically intelligent responsive multifunctional electrolyte using a “nano-friction-strengthening” strategy to dynamically reinforce its mechanical robustness. The high-polarity carbonate solvents spontaneously infiltrate the hydroxyl-rich poly(hydroxyethyl methacrylate-diethyl allyphosphonate) shell and induce a hydrogen-bond-driven, self-regulated swelling response that enables uniform nanoparticle dispersion. Under impact, the intimate interfacial contact between core-shell nanoparticles instantaneously activates a dense network of dynamic hydrogen bonds within the swollen shell, boosting interparticle friction and adhesion. This molecularly orchestrated nano-friction-strengthening effect endows the electrolyte with impact hardening, driving a 160-fold surge in viscosity and delivering highly effective mechanical protection. Consequently, the electrolyte attenuates impact forces by 73.1%, enabling single Li‖LiFePO 4 pouch cells to endure impact without short-circuiting. Beyond mechanical reinforcement, the phosphate-ester groups in nanoparticles suppress exothermic chain reactions, ensuring safe operation during nail-penetration and ballistic tests in ampere-hour-scale Li‖LiFePO 4 cells.
papers.summary_ko: 무인기, 인간형 로봇 등 기계적 충격 위험이 큰 환경에서 사용되는 리튬금속전지의 안전성을 높이기 위해 '나노마찰 강화' 전략을 적용한 기계적응형 전해질을 설계했다. 고극성 카보네이트 용매가 하이드록실이 풍부한 코어-쉘 나노입자 쉘에 침투해 수소결합 기반 팽윤 반응을 유도하며, 충격 시 입자 간 마찰과 접착력이 급격히 증가해 점도가 160배 상승한다. 이를 통해 충격력을 73.1% 감쇄시켜 Li‖LiFePO4 단위 셀이 단락 없이 충격을 견디고, 암페어시급 셀에서도 못 관통 및 발사 시험에서 안전성을 확보했다.

papers.title: Hyperconjugation‐Mediated Design of Dissolution‐Resistant Organic Cathode for Durable Zinc‐Ion Batteries
papers.abstract_en: Small‐molecule organic carbonyl compounds (SMOCCs) have emerged as promising cathode candidates for aqueous zinc‐ion batteries (AZIBs) by virtue of their high theoretical capacity and tunable redox potential. However, their practical implementation is severely impeded by intrinsically poor electronic conductivity and pronounced dissolution in aqueous electrolytes, leading to unsatisfactory rate capability and cyclic stability. Herein, we report a hyper‐conjugative structural design strategy to construct a TAPT@rGO composite, in which 2,3,5,6‐tetraamino‐1,4‐benzoquinone (TABQ) and 1,10‐phenanthroline‐5，6‐dione (PTD) are covalently integrated with graphene oxide (GO) to yield a nitrogen‐heteroatom‐extended conjugated framework. This architecture not only ensures homogeneous dispersion of nanosized TAPT crystallites on the rGO substrate, but also establishes an N‐heterocycle‐mediated extended conjugation linkage between the organic species and the carbon scaffold, which synergistically enhances electronic transport kinetics and suppresses active material dissolution. As a cathode for AZIBs, the TAPT@rGO composite delivers a high initial capacity of 271 mAh g −1 at 0.1 A g −1 with an average operating voltage of 0.8 V, together with exceptional cycling stability (93.5% capacity retention over 100 cycles at 0.1 A g −1 and 82.5% retention over 10000 cycles at 5 A g −1 ). This work demonstrates that hyperconjugation engineering provides a rational molecular design for developing high‐performance organic cathodes toward durable multivalent ion storage.
papers.summary_ko: 수계 아연이온전지(AZIB)용 소분자 유기 카보닐 화합물의 낮은 전도성과 용해 문제를 해결하기 위해 TABQ와 PTD를 그래핀옥사이드에 공유결합으로 통합한 TAPT@rGO 복합 양극을 제안했다. 질소 헤테로원자 기반의 확장된 공액구조가 전자 전달과 활물질 용해 억제를 동시에 개선하여 0.1 A g−1에서 271 mAh g−1의 초기 용량과 10000회 사이클(5 A g−1)에서 82.5%의 용량 유지율을 달성했다. 리튬/소듐 배터리가 아닌 아연이온전지 연구로 7개 토픽 범주에는 해당하지 않는다.

papers.summary_ko: 제목에 기반하면, 황화물 및 황-탄소 계면을 정밀 설계하여 고로딩 전고체 리튬-황 전지의 성능을 향상시키는 연구로 추정된다 (제목 기반 추정).

papers.title: Four-dimensional X-ray nano-holotomography reveals multiscale chemomechanics in composite graphite–silicon battery electrodes
papers.abstract_en: Linking electrode microstructure to electrochemical performance is essential for optimizing Li-ion batteries. However, this requires mechanistic four-dimensional observations at the ultimate spatiotemporal scales, which remain elusive. Here we demonstrate the use of interrupted-operando synchrotron X-ray nano-holotomography combined with digital volume correlation to track chemomechanical dynamics at both particle (local) and electrode (averaged) scales. Quantitative scale-bridging image analysis is applied to composite graphite–silicon electrodes during their electrochemical formation cycle. Our findings reveal that local ionic diffusion properties, graphite particle morphology and position in the electrode, distance to silicon clusters, surface contact with the liquid electrolyte solution, and mechanical deformations all directly affect local electrochemical activity and irreversibility, although these parameters are not equally important. In particular, we identify fast ionic diffusion channels that play a key role and counterbalance intrinsic depth-dependent reaction heterogeneities arising from ionic and electronic diffusion limitations. The various structural factors that determine the electrochemical performance of composite graphite–silicon electrodes in Li-ion batteries beyond ensemble properties are classified using a scale of influence, providing a practical framework for the optimization of materials and electrode manufacturing.
papers.summary_ko: 4차원 방사광 X선 나노홀로토모그래피와 디지털 체적 상관법을 결합해 흑연-실리콘 복합전극의 입자 및 전극 스케일 화학역학 거동을 관찰했다. 이온 확산 경로, 흑연 입자 형상·위치, 실리콘 클러스터와의 거리, 전해질 접촉, 기계적 변형 등이 국부적 전기화학 활성과 비가역성에 미치는 영향을 정량적으로 분석했다. 흑연-실리콘 음극의 구조-성능 관계를 규명하는 특성분석 연구로 7개 토픽 범주에는 해당하지 않는다.

papers.title: ER-associated biogenesis of PINK1 preprotein for neuronal mitophagy
papers.abstract_en: Given the large size of neurons, local maintenance of mitochondria is crucial to counteract insults to this organelle in axons and dendrites. The Parkinson-related mitochondrial kinase PINK1 plays a central role in mitochondrial quality control, which in neurons requires the transport of Pink1 mRNA by mitochondrial hitch-hiking. However, how and where PINK1 is locally translated and processed has remained unclear. Using live-cell imaging, we trace local PINK1 translation sites and preprotein dynamics, revealing a concerted interplay between mitochondria and the ER, with endolysosomes frequently localized adjacent to the site of translation. Upon metabolically regulated untethering from mitochondria, Pink1 mRNA relocates to ribosomes in proximity to the ER and endolysosomes for translation of the PINK1 preprotein. The ER chaperone DNAJB6 shields the PINK1 preprotein in transit to mitochondria, following the post-translational ER-SURF pathway. Consequently, loss of DNAJB6 leads to persistent ER/endolysosome-associated PINK1 precursor stores and failure of mitophagy upon mitochondrial damage. Our findings reveal that neuronal PINK1 protein translation switches between mitochondrially anchored co-translational and ER-associated post-translational import states, with functional implications for mitochondrial quality control.
papers.summary_ko: 신경세포 내 PINK1 전구체 단백질이 소포체(ER)와 미토콘드리아 사이에서 번역 및 운반되는 과정을 live-cell 이미징으로 추적한 연구이다. ER 샤페론 DNAJB6가 PINK1 전구체를 미토콘드리아로 전달되기까지 보호하며, 이 단백질이 결손되면 미토파지가 실패함을 밝혔다. 배터리와 무관한 신경생물학 연구이다.

papers.title: Concentration‐Dependent Li‐Ion Solvation and Dual‐Interphase Regulation by Cyanuric Chloride in Lithium‐Sulfur Batteries
papers.abstract_en: Practical lithium‐sulfur (Li‐S) batteries require control of dissolved polysulfides, sulfur‐conversion kinetics, and lithium‐metal anodes under high sulfur loading and limited electrolyte. Dissolved molecular additives can influence all three processes, but their effects depend on concentration. Here, cyanuric chloride (CC) is examined from 0 to 0.10 M as an aprotic chlorotriazine additive with three ring‐nitrogen sites and three carbon‐chlorine centers. Spectroscopy suggests that 0.05 M (Optm‐CC) enhances nitrate (NO 3 − ) and bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide (TFSI − ) anions’ participation in Li‐ion solvation. This concentration reduces polysulfide crossover, enriches the sulfur‐cathode interphase with inorganic and triazine‐associated products, and promotes an inorganic‐rich, Cl‐containing interphase at the lithium‐metal anode. As a result, these changes lower cyclic‐voltammetry peak separation to 0.191 V, raise the apparent Li|Li exchange‐current density to 0.203 mA cm −2 , support Li|Li symmetric‐cell cycling for over 1100 cycles, deliver 560 mAh g Sulfur −1 at 10C, and sustain 3000 Li‐S cycles. Increasing the CC concentration to 0.10 M (Conc‐CC) produces a larger spectroscopic shift, but the apparent Li‐ion transference number and lithium‐electrode polarization deteriorate. Furthermore, a pouch cell operated at 8 mg Sulfur cm −2 and 5 µL mg Sulfur − 1 retains 72.73% of its stabilized capacity after 300 cycles. Among the tested formulations, 0.05 M best balances coordination, interphase chemistry, and electrochemical performance.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬-황 전지에서 농도에 따라 거동이 달라지는 시아누르산 클로라이드(CC) 첨가제를 0~0.10 M 범위에서 평가했다. 0.05 M 농도(Optm-CC)는 NO3−와 TFSI− 음이온의 Li+ 솔베이션 참여를 늘려 폴리설파이드 셔틀을 줄이고, 황 양극과 리튬 음극 모두에 무기물이 풍부한 계면을 형성시켜 Li|Li 대칭셀 1100회 이상, 10C에서 560 mAh gS−1, 3000회 Li-S 사이클을 달성했다. 반면 0.10 M(Conc-CC)에서는 리튬 전극 분극이 악화되어 8 mg cm−2 파우치셀은 300회 후 72.73% 용량을 유지했다.

papers.title: Cathode Surface Reconfiguration via Solvent Chemistry for Durable All-Solid-State Lithium Batteries
papers.venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.abstract_en: Electrode surfaces and interfaces critically dominate the performance of all-solid-state lithium batteries. However, established additive-oriented strategies physically isolate the cathode from the electrolyte without improving the restricted Li+ transport pathways of the cathode surface. Here, we propose a solvation-mediated chemical etching mechanism governing cathode surface reconfiguration, driven by competition between solvent coordination and lattice stabilization. The solvent coordination, coupled with electron and proton transfer, weakens transition-metal–oxygen covalency and destabilizes lattice-bound surface species, shifting the interfacial energy landscape toward solvation-favored states. This triggers selective transition-metal dissolution and oxygen modulation, ultimately reorganizing confined surface regions into continuous Li+ transport networks. Using micron-sized single-crystalline Li- and Mn-rich cathodes as a model, we demonstrate the formation of a Mn- and O-deficient interfacial layer equipped with a three-dimensional Li+ diffusion network. This functional layer accelerates Li+ diffusion and anionic redox kinetics while suppressing transition metal migration and oxygen release. Consequently, charge-transfer resistance drops drastically (from 585 to 67 Ω) and Li+ diffusion increases 90-fold at 4.8 V, enabling 80.3% capacity retention after 2800 cycles at 2C. This solvent-driven reconfiguration provides a scalable framework for stabilizing diverse cathodes in next-generation advanced batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 전고체 리튬전지에서 첨가제 기반 전략이 양극 표면의 제한된 Li+ 경로를 근본적으로 개선하지 못하는 문제를 해결하기 위해, 용매 배위와 격자 안정화의 경쟁을 이용한 용매화 매개 화학적 식각으로 양극 표면을 재구성하는 메커니즘을 제안했다. 단결정 Li- 및 Mn-rich 양극을 모델로 하여 Mn 및 O가 결핍된 3차원 Li+ 확산망을 가진 계면층을 형성시켜 전하전달저항을 585Ω에서 67Ω으로 낮추고 4.8V에서 Li+ 확산을 90배 향상시켰다. 그 결과 2C에서 2800회 사이클 후 80.3%의 용량 유지율을 달성했다.

papers.title: Built‐In Electric Field Creates Li + Highways With Accelerating and Dissociating Regions for Solid‐State Polymer Electrolytes
papers.abstract_en: Solid‐state polymer electrolytes based on poly (ethylene oxide) (PEO) are promising candidates for next‐generation lithium‐metal batteries, yet their practical application is hindered by low ionic conductivity and limited Li + transference number, originating from insufficient salt dissociation and passive ion transport. Here, we introduce a MoSe 2 /TiF 4 heterojunction into the PEO matrix to construct an ion‐conducting network with integrated accelerating and dissociating functionalities. The built‑in electric field at the heterointerface actively promotes rapid Li + migration, while the Lewis acid‐base interactions facilitate efficient LiTFSI dissociation. Benefiting from this synergistic heterojunction effect, the resulting composite electrolyte achieves a high ionic conductivity of 1.09 × 10 −4 S cm −1 at room temperature, a Li + transference number of 0.55, and enables stable Li||Li symmetric cycling for over 2500 h at 60°C. Both LiFePO 4 || Li and LiNi 0.8 Co 0.1 Mn 0.1 O 2 ||Li all‑solid‑state batteries demonstrate excellent cycling stability and rate capability. Combined electrochemical analysis and density functional theory calculations confirm that the heterojunction‑induced built‑in electric field plays a central role in accelerating Li + transport and promoting salt dissociation. This heterojunction engineering strategy provides a viable pathway toward high‑performance polymer electrolytes for practical solid‑state batteries.
papers.summary_ko: PEO 기반 고체 고분자 전해질의 낮은 이온전도도와 리튬 이동수 문제를 해결하기 위해 MoSe2/TiF4 헤테로접합을 도입하여 Li+ 가속 및 해리 기능을 동시에 갖는 이온전도 네트워크를 구축했다. 계면의 내부전기장이 Li+ 이동을 촉진하고 루이스 산-염기 상호작용이 LiTFSI 해리를 도와 상온 이온전도도 1.09×10−4 S cm−1, Li+ 이동수 0.55, 60°C에서 2500시간 이상의 Li‖Li 대칭셀 안정성을 달성했다. LiFePO4와 NCM811 기반 전고체전지 모두에서 우수한 사이클 및 율속 특성을 보였으나 전해질 자체에 관한 연구로 7개 토픽 범주에는 해당하지 않는다.

papers.title: Molecular Engineering of Redox Mediator for Accelerated Multi‐Electron Transfer Reactions in Lithium Batteries
papers.abstract_en: Lithium–sulfur and lithium–oxygen batteries are highly attractive due to their ultrahigh theoretical energy densities, while their performance is severely constrained by sluggish multiphase reaction rates and limited reaction stability at the cathodes. The conventional solid‐phase catalysts suffer from small interfacial contact area and activity loss of active sites, while the mobile redox mediators (RMs) present a new paradigm for accelerating multi‐electron transfer pathways through a solution‐mediated electron transfer pathway. This review first discusses the critical rate‐limiting factors governing reaction rate at the cathode, and then systematically examines the latest advances in the molecular engineering of RMs for cathode catalysis from the viewpoint of redox potential, solubility, molecular size, and chemical stability. Following these points, we comprehensively analyze, from both thermodynamic and kinetic perspectives, how the molecular engineering of RMs affects the redox potential, solubility, stability, and so on. These characteristics strongly dictate the specific capacity and lifespan, elucidating key structure–activity relationships. Finally, we propose systemic strategies expanding beyond isolated liquid‐phase catalysis toward solid–liquid synergistic design and functionalized electrolyte/separator engineering.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬-황 및 리튬-산소 전지 양극의 느린 다상 반응속도 문제를 해결하기 위한 가용성 레독스 매개체(RM)의 분자설계를 리뷰했다. 레독스 전위, 용해도, 분자크기, 화학적 안정성 관점에서 RM의 구조-물성 관계를 정리하고, 액상 촉매작용을 넘어 고체-액체 시너지 설계와 전해질/분리막 기능화로 확장되는 전략을 제시한다.

papers.title: Advances and Perspectives of Cobalt‐Free Li‐Rich Mn‐Based Layered Oxide Cathodes
papers.abstract_en: Lithium‐rich manganese‐based oxides (LRMOs) are prioritized for next‐generation batteries due to their high theoretical specific capacity and energy density. In particular, the cobalt‐free LRMOs offer additional competitive advantages due to their lowered production cost and reduced resource dependence. However, the cobalt‐free LRMOs still suffer from persistent structural stability challenges, exhibiting low initial Coulombic efficiency, rapid capacity and voltage decay, and inferior rate capability. To advance cobalt‐free LRMO development, massive research efforts focused on effective regulation strategies have emerged recently. It is therefore imperative to timely summarize these recent works to systematically evaluate the attained achievements, recognize the unresolved issues, and formulate the key optimization approaches in the next stage; however, such related reviews for cobalt‐free LRMOs remain limited. Herein, we carefully examine the fundamental advances in cobalt‐free LRMOs and give a comprehensive review work. Initially, the microstructure of cobalt‐free LRMOs is dissected, and the corresponding electrochemical mechanism is elucidated. In addition, the faced challenges are described and analyzed in detail. More importantly, the currently proposed modification strategies are primarily discussed from the microstructure regulation, element doping and surface coating views. Finally, the significant perspectives are highlighted.
papers.summary_ko: 코발트가 없는 리튬리치 망간계 층상산화물(LRMO) 양극의 최근 연구 동향을 정리한 리뷰이다. 낮은 초기 쿨롱효율, 급격한 용량·전압 감쇠, 저조한 율속 특성 등 구조 안정성 문제를 미세구조, 원소 도핑, 표면 코팅 관점에서 분석하고 향후 개선 방향을 제시한다.

papers.title: Synergistic electronic push–pull modulation enables reversible Mn/O redox in P2-type cathodes
papers.summary_ko: 제목에 기반하면, P2형 소듐 양극재에서 전자구조의 push-pull 조절을 통해 가역적인 Mn/O 레독스를 구현하는 연구로 추정된다 (제목 기반 추정).
